text:
hana: Quick thread for next week's social push: benchmark blog + webinar. Need final copy + hero image by EOD so we can schedule X/LinkedIn.
vik: I'll own the hero image and export PNGs. Target sizes: LI single image 1200x627, X single card 1200x675.
hana: Topline plan: 1) LinkedIn single-image post (data highlight + link) 2) X thread teaser w/ screenshot 3) two reminder tweets. Also routing: tag new webinar leads 'bench-apr-24' in CRM.
jamie: Draft LinkedIn copy: "Production benchmarks that matter: median latency down, unit cost trimmed. Join our webinar to see config and rollout tips. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=bench_apr"
sam: X thread draft (3 tweets): Tweet1: Headline stat + hook Tweet2: short explainer + screenshot Tweet3: CTA + webinar link (add utm_source=x_thread). Keep tweet1 <280 chars and add image alt text.
vik: Uploaded draft hero: https://figma.com/file/hero987/export/hero.png Alt: 'bar chart comparing per-token cost across model configs'.
hana: Scheduling: LI Tue 10am PT, X-thread Tue 11am PT, Reminder Mon 3pm PT. social-scheduler, can you queue?
social-scheduler: queued -> Buffer. LI: 2024-04-16T17:00:00Z, X-thread: 2024-04-16T18:00:00Z, Reminder: 2024-04-15T22:00:00Z.
jamie: Follow-up plan: reply to thread with 30s clip + blog link 24h after webinar; 3 days after send LI message to registrants who didn't attend. Sam will own DM copy.
sam: will draft DM and post here by EOD.
hana: please react :thumbsup: by 3pm to approve copy and assets; otherwise we'll assume go-ahead and schedule at 3:15pm.
